description: Route-contract ratchet: entries may only be REMOVED (by fixing the route, the verb, the declaration, or the client); a NEW violation in any section fails CI. Sections: unmatchedClientCalls (client calls with no SERVICE_CONFIGS entry on path AND method; "[ANY]" = client method not determinable), gatewayGhostEndpoints (declared endpoints with no matching backend controller route, in upstream form), gatewayUndeclaredBackendRoutes (backend controller routes absent from SERVICE_CONFIGS, in upstream form). Regenerate with: node scripts/check-route-contracts.mjs --update
